# Audio Player

> A styled player over the native audio element: play and pause, a seek bar, current time and duration, volume and mute, playback speed, and a title, all keyboard friendly.

## Usage

```twig
<twig:AudioPlayer src="/media/episode-12.mp3" title="Episode 12" subtitle="The Symfony podcast" />
```

## Examples

### Basic

Play, pause, seek and read the time. The sample is two seconds of silence, so the controls can be tried without sound.

<!-- height: 180 -->

```twig
<twig:AudioPlayer src="data:audio/wav;base64," title="Episode 12" subtitle="The Symfony podcast" />
```

### Minimal

Without the volume and speed controls.

<!-- height: 160 -->

```twig
<twig:AudioPlayer src="data:audio/wav;base64," :showVolume="false" :showSpeed="false" title="Voice memo" />
```

### No Title

Only the controls.

<!-- height: 140 -->

```twig
<twig:AudioPlayer src="data:audio/wav;base64," label="Sample" />
```

### Custom Speeds

`speeds` is the list the speed button cycles through.

<!-- height: 180 -->

```twig
<twig:AudioPlayer src="data:audio/wav;base64," :speeds="[1, 1.5, 2, 3]" title="Lecture" />
```

### Playlist

Several players on one page: starting one pauses the others.

<!-- height: 420 -->

```twig
<div class="grid gap-2">
    <twig:AudioPlayer src="data:audio/wav;base64," title="Track 1" :showVolume="false" />
    <twig:AudioPlayer src="data:audio/wav;base64," title="Track 2" :showVolume="false" />
</div>
```

### Another Language

All texts are props.

<!-- height: 180 -->

```twig
<twig:AudioPlayer src="data:audio/wav;base64," title="Épisode 12" playLabel="Lecture" pauseLabel="Pause" seekLabel="Position" volumeLabel="Volume" muteLabel="Couper le son" unmuteLabel="Rétablir le son" speedLabel="Vitesse de lecture {speed}" />
```

## Accessibility

- The play button changes its accessible name between play and pause; the seek and volume bars are native range inputs, keyboard friendly, with a readable value for the seek bar.
- The speed and mute buttons announce their state through their names.
- Only one player plays at a time, so sounds do not pile up.
- Offer a transcript for spoken content.

## Extending

- `audio-player:play`, `audio-player:pause` and `audio-player:end`.

## API

### `<twig:AudioPlayer>`

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | string | | The audio file. |
| `title` | string or null | `null` | The title above the controls. |
| `subtitle` | string or null | `null` | A line under the title. |
| `speeds` | array | `1, 1.25, 1.5, 2, 0.75` | The speeds the speed button cycles through. |
| `showVolume` | bool | `true` | Show the volume and mute controls. |
| `showSpeed` | bool | `true` | Show the speed button. |
| `preload` | `none`, `metadata`, `auto` | `metadata` | How much of the file is loaded early. |
| `playLabel` | string | `Play` | The name of the play button. |
| `pauseLabel` | string | `Pause` | The name of the pause button. |
| `seekLabel` | string | `Seek` | The name of the seek bar. |
| `volumeLabel` | string | `Volume` | The name of the volume bar. |
| `muteLabel` | string | `Mute` | The name of the mute button. |
| `unmuteLabel` | string | `Unmute` | The name of the unmute button. |
| `speedLabel` | string | `Playback speed {speed}` | The name of the speed button. |
| `label` | string | `Audio player` | The accessible name when there is no title. |

| Block | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | Not used. |
